title: Unnati Hooda, Tanvi Sharma Qualify for Taipei Open Semifinal
indian_angle: Two promising Indian women's singles players have advanced to the semifinals of an international tournament, showcasing India's depth in the sport.
summary: Young Indian shuttlers Unnati Hooda and Tanvi Sharma have both secured their spots in the semifinals of the Taipei Open 2026, defeating their respective quarter-final opponents.

title: Player Eligibility for World Junior Championships 2026 Announced
indian_angle: This circular outlines the eligibility criteria for Indian junior players aiming to represent the nation at the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships in Cairo.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released a circular detailing the player eligibility requirements for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships 2026, scheduled to be held in Cairo, Egypt.

title: BAI Issues Circular for Form-1 for Badminton Sportspersons
indian_angle: This administrative update from BAI is crucial for Indian badminton players to ensure proper documentation for their participation in various events.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has circulated guidelines for the issuance of Form-1, a mandatory document for badminton sportspersons, streamlining administrative processes for players.

title: 3x15 Scoring System Adopted for Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: This new scoring system will fundamentally change how junior domestic tournaments are played in India, potentially impacting player development and match dynamics.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of a 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and National Championships across the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.

title: PV Sindhu Claims Japan Open Crown, Ends Title Drought
indian_angle: This victory marks a significant comeback for India's star shuttler PV Sindhu, silencing critics and reaffirming her status as a top contender on the world stage.
summary: PV Sindhu secured a scorching victory at the Japan Open, defeating home contender Akane Yamaguchi in the final to claim her maiden title at the event and end a prolonged title drought.

title: Delhi to Host World Championships 2026, Focus on Gen Z Fans
indian_angle: India will host the prestigious BWF World Championships in Delhi in 2026, aiming to attract a new generation of fans and boost badminton's popularity in the country.
summary: With Delhi set to host the BWF World Championships in 2026, there's a strategic focus on engaging younger audiences, including Gen Z and Gen Alpha, to ensure the sport's continued growth and appeal in India.
